allies.explain: A Disciples of Be'lakor army's Chaos Knights ally must be from House Korvax. Choose House Korvax for the Knight.

armiesOfRenown.source: Wahapedia, Arks of Omen: Grand Tournament, Battle Brothers (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k9ed/the-rules/arks-of-omen-grand-tournament/); research library 01_Core_Rules/Army_Building_Detachments_and_CP.md §7.5: a LEGIONES DAEMONICA Arks of Omen Detachment in a Disciples of Be'lakor army may take two allies, one TRAITORIS ASTARTES Patrol and one CHAOS KNIGHTS Super-heavy Auxiliary with one HOUSE KORVAX unit. In BSData v9.8.0 only the Chaos Space Marines catalogue gives its units the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword.
